ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels; black pixels are localized strictly at the trailing edge perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity light-gray region across the entire ventral surface, bounded by a thin, non-uniform high-contrast black band along the trailing edge; presence of 8 to 10 discrete yellowish-brown circular focal spots distributed mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with pixel-amplitudes between 5 and 15 pixels; edge profile shows significant irregular jaggedness particularly on the distal third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear sweep from the notch transitioning to a slight convexity at the outer lobes; the distal tips exhibit a fragmented geometric profile due to calcified clusters.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Symmetrical distribution of approximately 9 yellowish-brown circular pixel clusters across the mid-ventral lobes; dense clusters of high-contrast white/tan calcified barnacle colonies at the extreme lateral tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified barnacle encrustations localized on the lateral lobe tips, creating a high-contrast textured boundary distinct from the fluke's pigment.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique semi-symmetrical pattern of dark-yellow circular spots resembling a constellation across the central ventral surface.
